name: Doh-Khlieh
ingredients: Optional: boiled pig brain for extra creaminess
Optional: steamed green peas or carrots
instructions: 1. Boil the pork until tender, then drain and mince it finely.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the minced pork with the finely chopped onions, ginger, and green chilies.
3. Add salt to taste and mix thoroughly by hand to ensure the flavors are well-incorporated.
4. If using pig brain, mash it gently and mix it into the pork for added texture.
5. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and optional steamed vegetables before serving.
description: Doh-Khlieh is a traditional salad from the Khasi community of Meghalaya. It is a staple at local festivities and gatherings, celebrated for its simplicity, fresh ingredients, and distinct, clean flavors that highlight the quality of the meat.
